figures.caption: Figure 1: Schematic comparison of classical transformations of spikes for four neurons A, B, C and D. The simulation stops at t = 6, so the frequency of neuron A is 2 6 = 0.33. However, the first and last spikes outputted by neuron A are at t = 1 and t = 3 so its average ISI is 3−1

Figure 2: Illustration of the preprocessing of spiking activity with p = 0.5. Spikes are stored in memory, and each time 50% of the input neurons have outputted at least one spike, the average ISIs are computed (spikes considered are in red brackets), creating an image Is. In this example, we have I1 = (0,∞,∞,∞, 2/1, 4/4) . Red arrows indicate neurons with ISI manually set to zero. Greyed-out zones are temporal windows with no activity, so no computations happen.

Figure 3: Illustration of the preprocessing of a sample of the word ”Down” from the GSC dataset. From bottom to top: raw signal, log-Mel Spectrogram used to apply the speech2spike (Stewart et al., 2023) algorithm, and raster plots for negative and positive channels of our event2time algorithm. All plots share the same x-axis, with time in seconds.
Figure 5: Accuracy-Latency tradeoff. On top left: Accuracy for different values of R. On top right: Latency for different values of R. On bottom: accuracy as a function of latency.

Figure 6: Percentage of rank changes for each layer of the three models. Each column correspond to a certain layer, counting from the output layer. Each line is a label of the GSC dataset. The shaded area is a 95% confidence interval on the proportion of rank changes, and the average is computed over 100 samples for each label.
Figure 7: Importance of memory as computed in equation 14 for the first layer of three architectures. Averaged over 100 samples of the word label ”Forward”.

Figure 8: Average over neurons of the value 14 for each past timestep of the memory, for the first hidden layer of each model. Standard deviation in shaded colored area. Averaged over 100 samples of the word label ”Forward”.
Figure C.1: Lengths of sequences created by the preprocessing algorithm, for different labels of the GSC dataset. .
